thread:
maya: Anyone else seeing console heatmap freeze after the telemetry sampler change? first interaction hangs ~2-3s on canary.

sam: yep. repro'd on eu-canary. Flame shows large main-thread parse + chunk eval when heatmap opens.

jorge: can you paste profiler stack? sounds like eager import of telemetry utils. we changed sampler to sample more aggressively last night.

maya: attaching quick log snippet: ```main-thread: eval bundle 33mb -> parse 210ms; telemetry:init 180ms; kv-prefetch 320ms``` not exact numbers but visible.

liz: i also noticed bundle size for metrics-pane increased ~80kb gzip after the telemetry helper landed. maybe telemetry import pulled in intl polyfills? :thinking_face: 

sam: looks like routing policy change yesterday routed more dashboard traffic to the same prefetched client; kv-prefetch concurrency spiked. that combined with eager telemetry import => contention.

maya: minimal repro: open dashboard with heatmap, click series -> freeze. disabling kv-prefetch via local flag removes the freeze.

jorge: temporary mitigations: 1) revert telemetry sampler rollout (reduce sampling rate) 2) lazy-load telemetry client behind feature gate 3) throttle prefetch concurrency. we should do 1+3 quick.

maya: i've queued a canary rollback for the sampler on eu-canary now.

deploy-bot: canary-rollback initiated by maya. build 2026.03.21-28 -> roll back telemetry-sampler to v1.2.3

sam: i reduced prefetch concurrency in a hotfix on canary as well (prefetch.concurrency=2)

liz: follow-up: i'll audit the telemetry import tree for accidental polyfills and try to split the collector into a tiny stub + dynamic loader.

jorge: long term: routing heuristics should avoid concentrating dashboard traffic post-rollout. add a routing soft cap and fallback to other regions for heavy prefetch routes.

maya: thanks team. canary looks better after rollback + concurrency tweak, heatmap opens smoothly. I'll schedule a postmortem with perf numbers.

sam: add notes to rollout checklist: check bundle delta and prefetch concurrency impact. :memo: 

liz: i'll open PR to lazy-import telemetry and remove intl pulls. cc @ops

maya: closing thread, will link PM notes once available.
